title: Germination

stage.name: Germination
stage.description: The coat splits and the first root pushes down into the soil.

intro: Before anything shows above ground, the roots go down.

questions.prompt: Which part comes out of the seed first?
questions.why: The first root, called the radicle, comes out first so the seedling can anchor itself and drink.

questions.prompt: Match the parts of a baby plant.
questions.why: The radicle becomes the root and the plumule becomes the shoot. Cotyledons are the seed leaves.

questions.prompt: Why does the root come before the shoot?
options: So the plant can anchor and drink before it grows up
Because roots grow faster in light
It doesn't matter which comes first
questions.why: A seedling needs water and a firm hold before it can support growth above ground.

questions.prompt: In a relationship, putting down roots means sharing what really matters to you, even before much shows on the outside.
questions.why: Values and honesty are the roots. They hold a relationship steady when the weather changes.

talk: What are two values you'd want your relationship to be rooted in?
